# GNK ASG Brand Hierarchy Rules

Status: locked preparation. This file is not part of the public portal build.

## Core hierarchy

1. Main story: GNK ASG.
2. Group framework: GNK DINAMO Ltd.
3. Supporting personal layer: Nermin Sefic as owner of the whole group, UBO, director, owner and author or approver of selected texts.

## Homepage rule

The homepage must remain primarily corporate. It should present GNK ASG, GNK DINAMO Ltd., financial profile, technology, market intelligence, documents, public information and portal functions.

The personal reference should be present but discreet.

## Use of personal reference

Use the personal reference where it is accurate and useful:

- owner of the whole group context
- UBO context
- director context
- owner context
- author context
- approval context
- editorial responsibility
- profile link

Do not make the personal reference the main visual or main headline on the homepage.

## Article and publication rule

Each publication should primarily strengthen the corporate story. The byline or approval layer may mention the personal role when accurate.

Use accurate labels:

- Prepared by GNK ASG Intelligence Desk
- Approved by Nermin Sefic, Director
- Author: Nermin Sefic, only when expressly confirmed

## Visual rule

Visuals should primarily carry GNK ASG and, where relevant, GNK DINAMO Ltd. The personal name may appear on author cards, article visuals, approval lines or profile visuals, but should not overpower the corporate identity.

## Search and content rule

Build visibility through useful corporate content, internal links, article pages, visual cards, profile pages and structured metadata. Do not use aggressive repetition.

## Final intent

The public should first understand GNK ASG and GNK DINAMO Ltd. The personal layer should add accountability, group ownership, directorship, authorship and credibility without becoming the primary story.
